HPI: 49-year-old with type 2 diabetes, poorly controlled despite insulin glargine nightly. Home glucose readings mostly above 250.
Assessment: Type 2 diabetes mellitus, poorly controlled.
Plan: Increase insulin glargine. Diabetes education referral.
